purpose: Frozen cross-generator local-jitter evaluation, not training or calibrated motion ground truth
source_selection: All video_000.mp4 through video_127.mp4 with their existing prompts.csv, no score-based selection
duration_cohort: 30s-labelled existing generation runs; actual duration recorded

sampling.window_starts: 0, floor((sampled_count-16)/2), sampled_count-16 on the original VBench sampling grid

repair_preprocessing: The identical torch bilinear antialiased full-frame resize to 384 square; rectangular inputs accepted only by this experimental adapter. No crop or native resize before the 8px warp. Verify bit-exact parity on a prior square training example.

analysis.primary: per-source equal mean of three windows and two CF seeds, then equal-weight sources
analysis.mae: mean absolute paired changes across all source-window-seed triples, NOT abs(mean delta)
analysis.relative_scale_check: delta_repair <= 0.1 * delta_origin only if Origin has positive inflation; diagnostic, not a shared physical unit

limitations: Three two-second windows do not measure all long-video frames or long-term temporal quality
An 8px displacement has a smaller relative size on a 480px frame than on prior 256px frames
These two cohorts test generator/content shift with the SAME intervention family, not unseen-nuisance generalization
No new human motion judgments: invariance is not proof of correct motion ranking
Historical generation checkpoints are not inferred from folder names; preserve available metadata and flag unavailable identity
